create_video_processor: create a Qwen3VLVideoProcessor instance for preprocessing video inputs for Qwen3-VL models
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to compute optimal video dimensions respecting pixel limits and temporal factors
sample_video_frames: sample video frames uniformly from a video given metadata with a target frame count or fps
preprocess_videos: preprocess a batch of video tensors by resizing, patchifying, and producing pixel_values_videos with grid dimensions
build_video_input_tensors: build pixel_values_videos and video_grid_thw tensors ready for Qwen3-VL model inference
